name: allocation-api

dependencies.name: hr-service
dependencies.description: Reads employee records from the organization's HR system to synchronise the employee directory.

description: The single backend of the allocation app: owns employees (synchronised from the HR system), skills and proficiency levels, engagements, staffing needs, allocations with their change history, and the availability and over-allocation calculations. Deployable on its own because it is the only holder of the data and the only caller of the HR system; the browser app talks only to it. Stores data in its Postgres database. It does not create employees by hand, approve allocations, or render any UI.
